{"id":1884270868,"question_id":3763,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 1 week","timestamp":1768339388,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"124 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1884270868/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Separate Squares I","memory":"198.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long double;\n    double checkmid(vector<vector<int>>& squares , double mid)\n    {\n        ll bottomarea = 0;\n        ll toparea = 0;\n        for(auto &square : squares)\n        {\n            ll boty = square[1];\n            ll side = square[2];\n            ll topy = boty + side;\n\n            if(mid >= topy) bottomarea += (side * side);\n            else if(mid <= boty) toparea += (side * side);\n            else\n            {\n                toparea += (topy - mid) * side;\n                bottomarea += (mid - boty) * side;\n            }\n        }\n    return bottomarea - toparea;\n    }\n\n    double separateSquares(vector<vector<int>>& squares) {\n        int maxy = INT_MIN;\n        for(auto &square : squares)\n        {\n            maxy = max(maxy , square[1] + square[2]);\n        }\n        \n        double s = 0;\n        double e = maxy;\n        double ans = -1;\n\n        while(e - s > 1e-5)\n        {   \n            double mid = s + (e-s)/2.0;\n            \n            double diff = checkmid(squares , mid);\n            if(diff >= 0)\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                e = mid;\n            } \n            else s = mid;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"separate-squares-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1482}
